newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Treasury March op surplus at 536 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Treasury March op surplus at 536 mln reais.

text.p: Brazil's Treasury said it posted an operational budget surplus of 536 million reais in March, against a deficit of 308 million reais in February.
The operational budget includes debt servicing costs.

The Treasury's primary account, which does not include interest payments, showed a surplus of 1.484 billion reais in March, bringing the year-to-date primary surplus to 1.996 billion reais or 1.01 percent of the gross domestic product (GDP).
The Treasury said in a statement March receipts totaled 9.328 billion reais, 16 percent lower than in the same period of 1996.
Last month's total expenses were 7.845 billion reais, against 6.959 billion reais in the same period of 1996.
